decisions.reason: As a flagship close to the established offer with no observed shortfall, organizational slack supports keeping it on the market.
It is not a flagship but builds on the established offer, and slack allows carrying it while its performance remains uncertain.
As a strategic flagship aligned with the firm's digital direction, slack supports retaining it despite uncertain results.
Non-flagship and more digitally uncertain, but without evidence of shortfall and with available slack, the firm can continue to carry it.
